title: Exploration of the pathophysiology of cluster headache (AVF) in PET-MRI using [18F]F13640
official: Exploration of the pathophysiology of cluster headache (AVF) in PET-MRI using [18F]F13640 F13640-AVF
summary:
Main objective: In a group of patients with episodic AVF, assessment of the difference:
- fixing the [18F]F13640 (for PET data), 
- perfusion, brain activity and functional connectivity (for MRI data)
between the active and inactive period of the disease.

sites.f: Hospices Civils De Lyon – Service de Neurologie fonctionnelle et épileptologie
